ar.question: المتوسط الحسابي لـ \( 7 \) أعداد مكتوبة على السبورة هو \( 24 \). عند مسح عدد واحد منها انخفض متوسط الأعداد الـ \( 6 \) المتبقية إلى \( 21 \). ما العدد الذي مُسح؟
ar.hint: العدد الممسوح = (مجموع الـ \( 7 \) أعداد الأصلي) ناقص (مجموع الـ \( 6 \) أعداد المتبقية)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نطرح مجموع الأعداد المتبقية من المجموع الكلي قبل المسح!

الخطوة 1: المجموع قبل المسح = \( 168 \)، والمجموع بعد المسح = \( 126 \).

الخطوة 2: العدد الممسوح = \( 168 - 126 = 42 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: إرجاع العدد \( 42 \) يعيد المتوسط إلى \( 24 \)!

en.hint: Erased number = (original sum of \( 9 \) numbers) minus (remaining sum of \( 8 \) numbers)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Compute \( 9\times 35 - 8\times 32 \)!

Step 1: Sum of all \( 9 \) numbers was \( 9 \times 35 = 315 \).

Step 2: Sum of the remaining \( 8 \) numbers is \( 8 \times 32 = 256 \).

Step 3: The erased number is \( 315 - 256 = 59 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( (256 + 59) \div 9 = 35 \)!

en.question: Between parallel lines \( L_1 \parallel L_2 \), a two-segment zigzag makes acute angles of \( 32^\circ \) with \( L_1 \) and \( 49^\circ \) with \( L_2 \) as shown. Find the middle bend angle \( x \) (in degrees).
en.hint: Draw a line through the middle vertex parallel to \( L_1 \) and \( L_2 \) so alternate interior angles add to \( x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Split \( x \) with an auxiliary parallel line into \( 32^\circ + 49^\circ \)!

Step 1: Draw line \( L_m \parallel L_1 \parallel L_2 \) through the middle vertex.

Step 2: Alternate interior angles transfer \( 32^\circ \) from \( L_1 \) and \( 49^\circ \) from \( L_2 \).

en.hint: Draw a line through the middle vertex parallel to \( L_1 \) and \( L_2 \) so alternate interior angles add to \( x \)!

💡 Key Idea: Split \( x \) with an auxiliary parallel line into \( 41^\circ + 54^\circ \)!

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 41 + 54 = 95 \) degrees!

en.question: Between parallel lines \( L_1 \parallel L_2 \), a two-segment zigzag makes acute angles of \( 44^\circ \) with \( L_1 \) and \( 63^\circ \) with \( L_2 \) as shown. Find the middle bend angle \( x \) (in degrees).
en.hint: Draw a line through the middle vertex parallel to \( L_1 \) and \( L_2 \) so alternate interior angles add to \( x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Split \( x \) with an auxiliary parallel line into \( 44^\circ + 63^\circ \)!

Step 1: Draw line \( L_m \parallel L_1 \parallel L_2 \) through the middle vertex.

Step 2: Alternate interior angles transfer \( 44^\circ \) from \( L_1 \) and \( 63^\circ \) from \( L_2 \).

Step 3: Thus \( x = 44^\circ + 63^\circ = 107^\circ \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 44 + 63 = 107 \) degrees!

en.question: In the diagram with \( L_1 \parallel L_2 \), the top acute angle is \( (2t+5)^\circ \), the bottom acute angle is \( (t+10)^\circ \), and the middle bend angle is \( 105^\circ \). Find \( t \).
en.hint: Set the sum of the two acute angles equal to the middle bend angle \( 105^\circ \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use the zigzag sum identity \( (2t+5) + (t+10) = 105 \)!

Step 2: Combine like terms: \( 3t + 15 = 105 \implies 3t = 90 \implies t = 30 \).

en.question: Between parallel lines \( L_1 \parallel L_2 \), a 3-segment zigzag starts on \( L_1 \) at acute angle \( 35^\circ \) (going down-right), bends at right-pointing vertex \( P = 92^\circ \), then bends at left-pointing vertex \( Q = 78^\circ \), and meets \( L_2 \) at acute angle \( x^\circ \) (going down-right). Find \( x \).
en.hint: Draw two horizontal helper lines through \( P \) and \( Q \), or use the alternating-peaks rule: \( 35 + 78 = 92 + x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Pass parallel helper lines through both bends \( P \) and \( Q \)!

Step 1: Through \( P \), the parallel splits \( 92^\circ \) into \( 35^\circ \) above and \( 57^\circ \) below.

Step 2: Through \( Q \), alternate interior angles copy \( 57^\circ \) above, leaving \( x = 78^\circ - 57^\circ = 21^\circ \) below!

✅ Quick Check: Alternating-sum check: \( 35 + 78 = 113 \) and \( 92 + 21 = 113 \)!

ar.hint: ارسم مستقيمين مساعدين يمران بـ \( P \) و\( Q \)، أو طبّق قاعدة تناوب الرؤوس: \( 35 + 78 = 92 + x \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نمرر موازيين مساعدين عند الرأسين \( P \) و\( Q \) ونتتبع التبادل الداخلي!

الخطوة 1: عند \( P \) يتبقى تحت الموازي \( 92 - 35 = 57^\circ \).

الخطوة 2: تنتقل بالتبادل إلى أعلى \( Q \) فيتبقى \( x = 78 - 57 = 21^\circ \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق بقاعدة التناوب: \( 35 + 78 = 92 + 21 \)!

en.question: Between parallel lines \( L_1 \parallel L_2 \), a 3-segment zigzag starts on \( L_1 \) at acute angle \( 42^\circ \) (going down-right), bends at right-pointing vertex \( P = 105^\circ \), then bends at left-pointing vertex \( Q = 81^\circ \), and meets \( L_2 \) at acute angle \( x^\circ \) (going down-right). Find \( x \).
en.hint: Draw two horizontal helper lines through \( P \) and \( Q \), or use the alternating-peaks rule: \( 42 + 81 = 105 + x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Pass parallel helper lines through both bends \( P \) and \( Q \)!

Step 1: Through \( P \), the parallel splits \( 105^\circ \) into \( 42^\circ \) above and \( 63^\circ \) below.

Step 2: Through \( Q \), alternate interior angles copy \( 63^\circ \) above, leaving \( x = 81^\circ - 63^\circ = 18^\circ \) below!

✅ Quick Check: Alternating-sum check: \( 42 + 81 = 123 \) and \( 105 + 18 = 123 \)!

en.question: When a rectangular paper strip is folded along a straight crease as shown, the uncovered acute angle between the folded edge and the remaining top edge is \( x = 34^\circ \). What is the crease angle \( \alpha \) (in degrees)?
en.hint: Since original and folded angles both equal \( \alpha \), solve \( 2\alpha + 34^\circ = 180^\circ \)!
en.explanation:

en.hint: Combine \( x + 2\alpha = 180^\circ \) with \( x = \alpha + 24^\circ \) to find \( \alpha \), then compute \( x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Substitute \( x = \alpha + 24^\circ \) into \( x + 2\alpha = 180^\circ \)!

Step 1: Along the straight edge, \( x + 2\alpha = 180^\circ \).

Step 2: Substituting \( x = \alpha + 24^\circ \) gives \( 3\alpha = 156^\circ \implies \alpha = 52^\circ \).

Step 3: Therefore \( x = 180^\circ - 2(52^\circ) = 76^\circ \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( x = 76^\circ \) and \( \alpha = 52^\circ \) satisfy both \( 76 + 2(52) = 180 \) and \( x = \alpha + 24^\circ \)!

en.question: A rising rectilinear staircase polygon has \( 3 \) right-angled steps, total width \( 14\text{ cm} \), and total height \( 9\text{ cm} \). What is its perimeter (in cm)?
en.hint: Slide all horizontal treads up and all vertical risers sideways to form a \( 14 \times 9 \) rectangle!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply the bounding-box perimeter rule \( P = 2(W + H) \)!

Step 1: All horizontal step treads sum to \( 14\text{ cm} \) and all vertical step risers sum to \( 9\text{ cm} \).

Step 2: Perimeter = \( 2(14 + 9) = 46\text{ cm} \).

✅ Quick Check: Notice the number of steps (\( 3 \)) does not change the perimeter \( 46 \) cm!

ar.hint: أزح جميع القطع الأفقية للأعلى والقطع الرأسية للجانب ليتكوّن مستطيل أبعاده \( 14 \times 9 \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: مجموع القطع الأفقية يساوي \( 14 \) والعمودية يساوي \( 9 \)!

الخطوة 1: المحيط يساوي محيط المستطيل المحيط: \( 2(14 + 9) = 46\text{ سم} \).

en.question: A \( 20\text{ cm} \times 14\text{ cm} \) rising staircase card has an additional rectangular inward U-notch of depth \( 5\text{ cm} \) and width \( 3\text{ cm} \) cut straight down into one horizontal tread. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the notched polygon?
en.hint: Pushing the bottom of the \( 3\text{ cm} \) notch up closes the gap in the horizontal tread, leaving two extra vertical walls of length \( 5\text{ cm} \) each!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Add \( 2 \times 5\text{ cm} \) for the two inward vertical walls to \( 2(20 + 14) \)!

Step 1: Without the U-notch, the staircase perimeter is \( 2(20 + 14) = 68\text{ cm} \).

Step 2: The notch replaces a \( 3\text{ cm} \) top segment with a \( 3\text{ cm} \) bottom segment (net \( 0 \) horizontal change) plus two vertical side walls of \( 5\text{ cm} \).

Step 3: New perimeter = \( 68 + 2 \times 5 = 78\text{ cm} \).

✅ Quick Check: Notice the notch width (\( 3\text{ cm} \)) cancels out completely—only twice the depth (\( 10 \) cm) is added!

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( 68 + 10 = 78 \) سم!

en.question: A \( 18\text{ cm} \times 12\text{ cm} \) rising staircase card has an additional rectangular inward U-notch of depth \( 4\text{ cm} \) and width \( 3\text{ cm} \) cut straight down into one horizontal tread. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the notched polygon?
en.hint: Pushing the bottom of the \( 3\text{ cm} \) notch up closes the gap in the horizontal tread, leaving two extra vertical walls of length \( 4\text{ cm} \) each!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Add \( 2 \times 4\text{ cm} \) for the two inward vertical walls to \( 2(18 + 12) \)!

Step 1: Without the U-notch, the staircase perimeter is \( 2(18 + 12) = 60\text{ cm} \).

Step 2: The notch replaces a \( 3\text{ cm} \) top segment with a \( 3\text{ cm} \) bottom segment (net \( 0 \) horizontal change) plus two vertical side walls of \( 4\text{ cm} \).

Step 3: New perimeter = \( 60 + 2 \times 4 = 68\text{ cm} \).

✅ Quick Check: Notice the notch width (\( 3\text{ cm} \)) cancels out completely—only twice the depth (\( 8 \) cm) is added!

ar.question: بطاقة متدرجة صاعدة أبعادها الكلية \( 18\text{ سم} \times 12\text{ سم} \) قُطع في إحدى درجاتها الأفقية تجويف مستطيل للداخل عمقه الرأسي \( 4\text{ سم} \) وعرضه \( 3\text{ سم} \). ما محيط المضلع الناتج بالسنتمتر؟

💡 الفكرة الأساسية: عرض التجويف يختصر مع قاعه، فلا يضاف للمحيط سوى ضعف العمق \( 2 \times 4 \)!

الخطوة 2: يضيف التجويف جدارين رأسيين مجموعهما \( 2 \times 4 = 8 \) سم، فالمحيط = \( 68 \) سم.

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( 60 + 8 = 68 \) سم!

en.question: In the \( 14\text{ cm} \times 8\text{ cm} \) rectangle shown, the shaded triangle has the entire bottom side as its base and its top vertex on the upper side of the rectangle. What is the area of the shaded triangle (in \( \text{cm}^2 \))?
en.hint: Base = \( 14 \) cm and perpendicular height = \( 8 \) cm regardless of where the apex slides along the top edge!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use \( A = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} \) = half the rectangle!

Step 1: The triangle's base is \( 14\text{ cm} \) and its altitude between the parallel top and bottom sides is \( 8\text{ cm} \).

Step 2: Area = \( \frac{1}{2} \times 14 \times 8 = 56\text{ cm}^2 \).

✅ Quick Check: Shaded triangle is always exactly half of \( 14\times 8 = 112 \)!

ar.hint: طول القاعدة = \( 14 \) سم والارتفاع العمودي = \( 8 \) سم أينما وقع الرأس على الضلع العلوي!

en.question: A \( 12 \times 8 \) rectangle contains a shaded triangle whose vertices are the bottom-left corner, a point on the top side \( 4 \) units from the top-left corner, and a point on the right side \( 2 \) units above the bottom-right corner. Find the area of the shaded triangle.

Step 3: Shaded area = \( 96 - (16 + 12 + 24) = 44 \).

en.question: A \( 16 \times 8 \) rectangle contains a shaded triangle whose vertices are the bottom-left corner, a point on the top side \( 6 \) units from the top-left corner, and a point on the right side \( 4 \) units above the bottom-right corner. Find the area of the shaded triangle.
en.hint: Subtract the three unshaded corner right triangles from the \( 16 \times 8 = 128 \) rectangle!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Compute \( 16\times 8 - (T_1 + T_2 + T_3) \)!

Step 1: Rectangle area = \( 16 \times 8 = 128 \).

Step 2: The three outer right triangles have areas \( \frac{1}{2}(8)(6) = 24 \), \( \frac{1}{2}(16)(4) = 32 \), and \( \frac{1}{2}(10)(4) = 20 \).

Step 3: Shaded area = \( 128 - (24 + 32 + 20) = 52 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 52 + 24 + 32 + 20 = 128 \)!

en.question: Rectangle \( ABCD \) has total area \( 64 \). Point \( P \) is the midpoint of the top side and point \( Q \) is the midpoint of the right side. What is the area of the shaded triangle connecting the bottom-left corner to \( P \) and \( Q \)?
en.hint: Express each of the three corner right triangles as a fraction of the rectangle: \( \frac{1}{4} \), \( \frac{1}{4} \), and \( \frac{1}{8} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use the midpoint fraction identity \( 1 - \left(\frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{8}\right) = \frac{3}{8} \)!

Step 1: Top-left right triangle has legs \( W \) and \( L/2 \), so area \( \frac{1}{4} LW \); bottom-right right triangle has legs \( L \) and \( W/2 \), also \( \frac{1}{4} LW \).

Step 2: Top-right right triangle has legs \( L/2 \) and \( W/2 \), so area \( \frac{1}{8} LW \).

Step 3: Shaded fraction is \( 1 - \frac{5}{8} = \frac{3}{8} \), giving \( \frac{3}{8} \times 64 = 24 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 16 + 16 + 8 + 24 = 64 \)!

ar.hint: عبّر عن كل مثلث ركني ككسر من مساحة المستطيل: \( \frac{1}{4} \) و\( \frac{1}{4} \) و\( \frac{1}{8} \)!

en.question: Rectangle \( ABCD \) has total area \( 128 \). Point \( P \) is the midpoint of the top side and point \( Q \) is the midpoint of the right side. What is the area of the shaded triangle connecting the bottom-left corner to \( P \) and \( Q \)?
en.hint: Express each of the three corner right triangles as a fraction of the rectangle: \( \frac{1}{4} \), \( \frac{1}{4} \), and \( \frac{1}{8} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use the midpoint fraction identity \( 1 - \left(\frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{8}\right) = \frac{3}{8} \)!

Step 1: Top-left right triangle has legs \( W \) and \( L/2 \), so area \( \frac{1}{4} LW \); bottom-right right triangle has legs \( L \) and \( W/2 \), also \( \frac{1}{4} LW \).

Step 2: Top-right right triangle has legs \( L/2 \) and \( W/2 \), so area \( \frac{1}{8} LW \).

Step 3: Shaded fraction is \( 1 - \frac{5}{8} = \frac{3}{8} \), giving \( \frac{3}{8} \times 128 = 48 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 32 + 32 + 16 + 48 = 128 \)!

en.question: A solid \( 3 \times 3 \times 3 \) cube is painted red on all \( 6 \) outer faces and cut into \( 27 \) unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly \( 1 \) red face(s)?
en.hint: Use \( 12(n-2) \) for 2 faces (edges), \( 6(n-2)^2 \) for 1 face (face interiors), and \( (n-2)^3 \) for 0 faces (inner core)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Peel the border layer so \( n - 2 = 1 \)!

Step 1: Here \( n = 3 \), so the interior edge length after removing corners/borders is \( n - 2 = 1 \).

Step 2: Applying the \( 1 \)-face formula gives \( 6 \) unit cubes.

✅ Quick Check: Census check: \( 8 + 12 + 6 + 1 = 27 \)!

ar.question: طُلي مكعب مصمت أبعاده \( 3 \times 3 \times 3 \) باللون الأحمر من جميع أوجهه الستة ثم قُطّع إلى \( 27 \) مكعب وحدة. كم مكعب وحدة له \( 1 \) وجه/أوجه حمراء بالضبط؟
ar.hint: استخدم \( 12(n-2) \) لوجهين، و\( 6(n-2)^2 \) لوجه واحد، و\( (n-2)^3 \) لصفر أوجه!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب \( n - 2 = 1 \) ونطبّق القانون المناسب لعدد الأوجه \( 1 \)!

الخطوة 1: طول الحرف الداخلي \( n - 2 = 1 \).

en.question: Unit cubes (\( 1\text{ cm} \times 1\text{ cm} \times 1\text{ cm} \)) are stacked into a single row of \( 3 \) adjacent columns of heights \( 3, 2, \) and \( 1 \) resting flat on a table, as shown. en.hint: Count exposed squares from 5 views: Top (\( 3 \)), Front + Back (\( 2 \times 6 \)), and Left + Right (\( 2 \times 3 \))!

💡 Key Idea: Project the solid onto Top, Front, Back, Left, and Right views!

Step 1: From the Top, we see \( 3 \) unit squares (one atop each column).

Step 3: From Left we see \( 3 \) squares, and from Right the step-faces also total \( 3 \) squares (\( 6 \) together). Total = \( 3 + 12 + 6 = 21 \).

✅ Quick Check: 3D voxel neighbor count confirms \( 21 \) exposed unit squares!

en.question: Unit cubes (\( 1\text{ cm} \times 1\text{ cm} \times 1\text{ cm} \)) are stacked into a single row of \( 3 \) adjacent columns of heights \( 5, 4, \) and \( 2 \) resting flat on a table, as shown. Every exposed outer unit square (excluding the bottom squares touching the table) is painted gold. How many unit squares are painted?
en.hint: Count exposed squares from 5 views: Top (\( 3 \)), Front + Back (\( 2 \times 11 \)), and Left + Right (\( 2 \times 5 \))!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Project the solid onto Top, Front, Back, Left, and Right views!

Step 1: From the Top, we see \( 3 \) unit squares (one atop each column).

Step 2: From Front and Back, each view shows \( 5 + 4 + 2 = 11 \) squares, giving \( 22 \) squares.

Step 3: From Left we see \( 5 \) squares, and from Right the step-faces also total \( 5 \) squares (\( 10 \) together). Total = \( 3 + 22 + 10 = 35 \).

✅ Quick Check: 3D voxel neighbor count confirms \( 35 \) exposed unit squares!

en.question: How many 3-digit even integers can be formed with distinct digits chosen from \( \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\} \)?
en.hint: Fill the units digit first (even), then the hundreds digit (cannot be \( 0 \)!), and finally the tens digit!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Lock in the restricted units digit first, then protect the hundreds place from \( 0 \)!

Step 1: Units place has \( 3 \) valid even choice(s).

Step 2: Hundreds place cannot use the chosen units digit (nor \( 0 \) if present), leaving \( 5 \) choices.

en.question: Using digits from \( \{0, 1, 2, 3, 4\} \) without repetition, how many 4-digit even integers can be formed?
en.hint: Split into two separate cases because \( 0 \) is both even and forbidden in the thousands place: Case 1 (units digit = \( 0 \)) + Case 2 (units digit \( \ne 0 \) even)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Split on whether the units digit is \( 0 \) or a non-zero even digit!

Step 1: Case 1 (units = \( 0 \)): thousands has \( 4 \) non-zero choices, hundreds \( 3 \), tens \( 2 \) \( \implies 24 \) numbers.

Step 2: Case 2 (units is one of the \( 2 \) non-zero even digits): thousands has \( 3 \) choices (not \( 0 \), not units), hundreds \( 3 \), tens \( 2 \) \( \implies 36 \) numbers.

Step 3: Add the two disjoint cases: \( 24 + 36 = 60 \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: lumping \( 0 \) with non-zero evens miscounts the thousands slot; \( 24 + 36 = 60 \) is exact!

ar.question: باستخدام الأرقام من \( \{0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6\} \) دون تكرار، كم عدداً رباعياً زوجياً يمكن تكوينه؟
ar.hint: قسّم الحل إلى حالتين منفصلتين لأن \( 0 \) زوجي وممنوع في خانة الألوف: الحالة ١ (الآحاد = \( 0 \)) + الحالة ٢ (الآحاد زوجي غير صفري)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نفصل حالة الآحاد = \( 0 \) عن حالة الآحاد الزوجي غير الصفري!

الخطوة 1: الحالة ١ (الآحاد = \( 0 \)): تعطي \( 60 \) عدداً.

الخطوة 2: الحالة ٢ (الآحاد زوجي غير صفري، \( 3 \) خيارات): تعطي \( 144 \) عدداً.

الخطوة 3: المجموع = \( 60 + 144 = 204 \) عدداً.

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق شامل: العدد الدقيق للأعداد الرباعية الزوجية هو \( 204 \)!

en.question: On the \( 2 \times 2 \) rectangular street grid shown, how many shortest paths go from corner \( A \) (bottom-left) to corner \( B \) (top-right) moving only East or North?
en.hint: Every shortest walk takes \( 2 \) East steps and \( 2 \) North steps (\( 4 \) steps total): compute \( \binom{4}{2} \)!

en.question: On the \( 5 \times 2 \) rectangular street grid shown, how many shortest paths go from corner \( A \) (bottom-left) to corner \( B \) (top-right) moving only East or North?
en.hint: Every shortest walk takes \( 5 \) East steps and \( 2 \) North steps (\( 7 \) steps total): compute \( \binom{7}{2} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Choose which \( 2 \) of the \( 7 \) steps go North!

Step 1: Any shortest path consists of \( 5 \) East and \( 2 \) North moves (\( 7 \) moves in all).

Step 2: Number of ways = \( \binom{7}{2} = 21 \) shortest paths.

✅ Quick Check: Corner-by-corner Pascal addition reaches \( 21 \) at \( B \)!

en.question: On a \( 4 \times 3 \) street grid from \( A(0,0) \) to \( B(4,3) \), a student walks only East or North and must pass through the library at \( L(2,1) \). How many shortest paths are possible?
en.hint: Multiply the number of paths from \( A \) to \( L \) by the number of paths from \( L \) to \( B \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Split the walk at checkpoint \( L(2,1) \) and multiply!

Step 1: From \( A(0,0) \) to \( L(2,1) \): \( \binom{3}{2} = 3 \) paths.

Step 2: From \( L(2,1) \) to \( B(4,3) \): \( \binom{4}{2} = 6 \) paths.

Step 3: By multiplication, total paths through \( L \) = \( 3 \times 6 = 18 \).

✅ Quick Check: Notice \( 18 \) is strictly less than the unconditioned total \( 35 \)!

ar.question: على شبكة الشوارع \( 5 \times 3 \) من \( A(0,0) \) إلى \( B(5,3) \)، التقاطع \( (2,2) \) مغلق (×). بالتحرك شرقاً أو شمالاً فقط، كم مساراً أقصر يتجنب التقاطع المغلق؟

الخطوة 2: المسارات الصالحة = \( 56 - 24 = 32 \).

en.question: A large bin contains plenty of \( 4 \) different colors of socks. What is the minimum number of items you must draw blindly to guarantee at least \( 3 \) of the same kind?
en.hint: Worst case takes \( 2 \) from each of the \( 4 \) categories, then add \( +1 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply \( c(k - 1) + 1 \)!

Step 1: The longest unlucky draw takes \( 2 \) from each of the \( 4 \) categories: \( 4 \times 2 = 8 \).

Step 2: Drawing \( 1 \) more item (\( 9 \) total) forces at least one category to hit \( 3 \).

✅ Quick Check: With \( 8 \) items you could hold \( 2 \) of each; \( 9 \) guarantees \( 3 \)!

ar.question: يحتوي صندوق كبير على وفرة من \( 4 \) أصناف مختلفة. ما أقل عدد يجب سحبه عشوائياً دون نظر لضمان الحصول على \( 3 \) على الأقل من الصنف نفسه؟
ar.hint: في أسوأ حالة تسحب \( 2 \) من كل صنف من الأصناف الـ \( 4 \)، ثم تضيف \( +1 \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب أسوأ حالة \( 4 \times (3 - 1) \) ثم نضيف \( 1 \)!

الخطوة 1: أسوأ سحب دون بلوغ الهدف هو \( 4 \times 2 = 8 \).

الخطوة 2: بإضافة عنصر واحد نحصل على الضمان عند \( 9 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عند \( 9 \) يستحيل أن تبقى جميع الأصناف عند \( 2 \) فأقل!

en.question: A pouch holds tokens in \( 4 \) colors with counts \( (2, 8, 9, 10) \). What is the minimum number of tokens you must draw without looking to guarantee at least \( 5 \) tokens of the same color?
en.hint: Watch out for colors that have fewer than \( 4 \) tokens—in the worst case you exhaust all of those scarce colors!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Cap each color's worst-case contribution at \( \min(\text{count}, 4) \) and add \( 1 \)!

Step 1: To avoid \( 5 \) of a kind for as long as possible, take \( \min(c_i, 4) \) from each color: \( 2 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 14 \).

Step 2: One additional token (\( 14 + 1 = 15 \)) must belong to a color that still has tokens left, pushing it to \( 5 \)!

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: blind \( 4(5-1)+1 = 17 \) overcounts scarce colors; \( 15 \) is exact!

Step 1: To avoid \( 5 \) of a kind for as long as possible, take \( \min(c_i, 4) \) from each color: \( 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 \).

Step 2: One additional token (\( 16 + 1 = 17 \)) must belong to a color that still has tokens left, pushing it to \( 5 \)!

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: blind \( 5(5-1)+1 = 21 \) overcounts scarce colors; \( 17 \) is exact!

ar.question: يحتوي كيس على أقراص من \( 5 \) ألوان بأعداد \( (2, 2, 8, 9, 10) \). ما أقل عدد من الأقراص يجب سحبه دون نظر لضمان الحصول على \( 5 \) أقراص على الأقل من اللون نفسه؟
ar.hint: انتبه للألوان التي يقل عددها عن \( 4 \)؛ ففي أسوأ حالة تُستنفد هذه الألوان القليلة بالكامل!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نأخذ من كل لون \( \min(c_i, 4) \) في أسوأ حالة ثم نضيف \( 1 \)!

الخطوة 1: أسوأ سحب دون تحقيق الشرط يجمع \( 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 \) قرصاً.

الخطوة 2: السحبة التالية (\( 17 \)) تضمن الوصول إلى \( 5 \) من لون واحد!

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عند \( 17 \) يتحقق الضمان مع مراعاة الألوان القليلة!

en.question: From the set of integers \( \{1, 2, 3, \dots, 20\} \), what is the minimum number of distinct integers you must select to guarantee that at least two selected integers add up to \( 21 \)?
en.hint: Pair the integers into \( 10 \) pigeonhole pairs that sum to \( 21 \): \( \{1,20\}, \{2,19\}, \dots, \{10,11\} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Create \( 10 \) complementary sum-boxes and apply Pigeonhole!

Step 1: Partition \( \{1, \dots, 20\} \) into \( 10 \) pairs summing to \( 21 \): \( \{1,20\}, \{2,19\}, \dots, \{10,11\} \).

Step 2: Worst case picks \( 1 \) number from each of the \( 10 \) pairs (for example, \( 1, 2, \dots, 10 \)) with no pair summing to \( 21 \).

Step 3: By Pigeonhole, the \( (10 + 1) \)-th number (\( 11 \)) must complete one of those pairs!

✅ Quick Check: With \( 10 \) numbers \( \{1, \dots, 10\} \), max sum is \( 9 + 10 = 19 < 21 \); \( 11 \) forces a pair!

ar.question: من مجموعة الأعداد الصحيحة \( \{1, 2, 3, \dots, 20\} \)، ما أقل عدد من الأعداد المختلفة يجب اختياره لضمان وجود عددين من بينها مجموعهما \( 21 \)؟
ar.hint: قسّم الأعداد إلى \( 10 \) زوجاً مجموع كل زوج منها \( 21 \): \( \{1,20\}, \{2,19\}, \dots \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نكوّن \( 10 \) صندوقاً زوجياً مجموع كل صندوق \( 21 \) ونطبق مبدأ برج الحمام!

الخطوة 1: عدد الأزواج المتكاملة هو \( 10 \) زوجاً.

الخطوة 2: في أسوأ حالة نختار عدداً واحداً من كل زوج (\( 10 \) أعداد)، والعدد التالي (\( 11 \)) يحسم وجود زوج كامل!

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( 10 + 1 = 11 \) هو الحد الأدنى للضمان!

en.question: In the partially filled \( 3 \times 3 \) additive magic square shown (center = \( 10 \), and the two other entries in the row of \( x \) are \( 16 \) and \( 2 \)), find the value of \( x \).
en.hint: First compute the magic sum from the center cell: \( S = 3 \times 10 = 30 \), then complete the row containing \( x \)!

en.question: In the partially filled \( 3 \times 3 \) additive magic square shown (center = \( 15 \), and the two other entries in the row of \( x \) are \( 14 \) and \( 19 \)), find the value of \( x \).
en.hint: First compute the magic sum from the center cell: \( S = 3 \times 15 = 45 \), then complete the row containing \( x \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use \( S = 3 \times 15 = 45 \) and subtract the two known entries in \( x \)'s row!

Step 1: Since the center cell is \( 15 \), the magic sum of every row, column, and diagonal is \( S = 3 \times 15 = 45 \).

Step 2: In the row containing \( x \), \( x + 14 + 19 = 45 \implies x = 12 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 12 + 14 + 19 = 45 = 3 \times 15 \)!

en.question: In the \( 3 \times 3 \) additive magic square shown, only two cells are given: the middle-right edge cell is \( 13 \) and the bottom-middle edge cell is \( 19 \). What is the value of the top-left corner \( x \)?
en.hint: Add the right column and bottom row, then compare with the main diagonal through \( x \) and the center \( c \) (using \( S = 3c \))!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use the Olympiad corner-average identity: \( 2x = 13 + 19 \)!

Step 1: Let the magic sum be \( S = 3c \) (center \( c \)), top-right be \( u \), bottom-left be \( v \), and bottom-right be \( w \).

Step 2: Notice \( (u + 13 + w) + (v + 19 + w) = 2S \), while the anti-diagonal gives \( u + c + v = S \) and main diagonal gives \( x + c + w = S \implies w = 2c - x \).

Step 3: Subtracting \( u + v = S - c = 2c \) leaves \( 13 + 19 + 2(2c - x) = 4c \implies 2x = 13 + 19 \implies x = 16 \)!

✅ Quick Check: Lo Shu sanity check: in \( [[8,1,6],[3,5,7],[4,9,2]] \), top-left \( 8 = (7 + 9)/2 \)—works in every \( 3\times 3 \) magic square!

💡 الفكرة الأساسية: في أي مربع سحري \( 3 \times 3 \)، كل ركن يساوي متوسط الحافتين المقابلتين غير المجاورتين له!

en.question: In the \( 3 \times 3 \) additive magic square shown, only two cells are given: the middle-right edge cell is \( 15 \) and the bottom-middle edge cell is \( 25 \). What is the value of the top-left corner \( x \)?
en.hint: Add the right column and bottom row, then compare with the main diagonal through \( x \) and the center \( c \) (using \( S = 3c \))!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use the Olympiad corner-average identity: \( 2x = 15 + 25 \)!

Step 1: Let the magic sum be \( S = 3c \) (center \( c \)), top-right be \( u \), bottom-left be \( v \), and bottom-right be \( w \).

Step 2: Notice \( (u + 15 + w) + (v + 25 + w) = 2S \), while the anti-diagonal gives \( u + c + v = S \) and main diagonal gives \( x + c + w = S \implies w = 2c - x \).

Step 3: Subtracting \( u + v = S - c = 2c \) leaves \( 15 + 25 + 2(2c - x) = 4c \implies 2x = 15 + 25 \implies x = 20 \)!

✅ Quick Check: Lo Shu sanity check: in \( [[8,1,6],[3,5,7],[4,9,2]] \), top-left \( 8 = (7 + 9)/2 \)—works in every \( 3\times 3 \) magic square!

ar.question: في المربع السحري الجمعي \( 3 \times 3 \) الموضّح، أُعطيت خانتان فقط: يمين الوسط \( 21 \) وأسفل الوسط \( 33 \). ما قيمة الركن العلوي الأيسر \( x \)؟
ar.hint: اجمع العمود الأيمن والصف السفلي وقارنهما بـ القطر الرئيسي المار بـ \( x \) والمركز \( c \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: في أي مربع سحري \( 3 \times 3 \)، كل ركن يساوي متوسط الحافتين المقابلتين غير المجاورتين له!

الخطوة 1: بجمع العمود الأيمن والصف السفلي وطرح القطر الثانوي نجد المتطابقة السحرية \( 2x = 21 + 33 \).

الخطوة 2: إذن \( x = \frac{21 + 33}{2} = 27 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق على مربع لو شو القياسي: \( 8 = (7 + 9)/2 \)، وهنا \( x = 27 \)!

en.question: A fair spinner is divided into \( 8 \) equal sectors labeled \( 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 \). In one spin, what is the probability of landing on a prime number?
en.hint: Count how many of the \( 8 \) equal sectors satisfy the condition and reduce the fraction!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Divide favorable sectors (\( 4 \)) by total equal sectors (\( 8 \))!

Step 1: Matching labels are \( 2, 3, 5, 7 \) (\( 4 \) favorable outcomes out of \( 8 \)).

Step 2: Probability = \( \frac{4}{8} = \frac{1}{2} \).

✅ Quick Check: Reduced check: \( \gcd(1, 2) = 1 \)!

ar.question: قُسم قرص دوار متكافئ إلى \( 8 \) قطاعات متساوية مرقمة بـ \( 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 \). عند تدويره مرة واحدة، ما احتمال توقف المؤشر عند عدد أولي؟
ar.hint: احسب عدد القطاعات التي تحقق الشرط من أصل \( 8 \) ثم بسّط الكسر!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نعدّ القطاعات المحققة للشرط ونقسمها على \( 8 \)!

الخطوة 1: عدد النواتج المواتية = \( 4 \) من أصل \( 8 \).

الخطوة 2: الاحتمال في أبسط صورة = \( \frac{1}{2} \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: الكسر المختزل هو \( \frac{1}{2} \)!

en.question: A fair spinner is divided into \( 6 \) equal sectors labeled \( 1, 4, 7, 9, 12, 16 \). In one spin, what is the probability of landing on a perfect square?
en.hint: Count how many of the \( 6 \) equal sectors satisfy the condition and reduce the fraction!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Divide favorable sectors (\( 4 \)) by total equal sectors (\( 6 \))!

Step 1: Matching labels are \( 1, 4, 9, 16 \) (\( 4 \) favorable outcomes out of \( 6 \)).

Step 2: Probability = \( \frac{4}{6} = \frac{2}{3} \).

✅ Quick Check: Reduced check: \( \gcd(2, 3) = 1 \)!

en.question: Two fair standard 6-sided dice are rolled simultaneously. What is the probability that the sum of the two top numbers equals 8?
en.hint: Count the favorable ordered pairs \( (a, b) \) in the \( 6 \times 6 = 36 \) outcome table!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Enumerate favorable ordered pairs out of \( 36 \) and simplify!

Step 1: There are \( 6 \times 6 = 36 \) equally likely ordered pairs \( (a, b) \).

Step 2: Counting every pair satisfying the condition gives \( 5 \) pairs.

Step 3: Probability = \( \frac{5}{36} = \frac{5}{36} \).

✅ Quick Check: Ordered-pair grid check over all \( 36 \) outcomes confirms \( 5 \) hits!

en.question: Two fair standard 6-sided dice are rolled simultaneously. What is the probability that the sum of the two top numbers is at most 4?
en.hint: Count the favorable ordered pairs \( (a, b) \) in the \( 6 \times 6 = 36 \) outcome table!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Enumerate favorable ordered pairs out of \( 36 \) and simplify!

Step 1: There are \( 6 \times 6 = 36 \) equally likely ordered pairs \( (a, b) \).

en.question: A jar contains \( 4 \) red marbles and \( 5 \) blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn one after another without replacement. What is the probability that both drawn marbles are red?
en.hint: Without replacement means the total drops from \( 9 \) on the 1st draw to \( 8 \) on the 2nd draw (\( 72 \) ordered pairs)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count ordered draws across \( 9 \times 8 = 72 \) outcomes without replacement!

Step 1: There are \( 9 \times 8 = 72 \) equally likely ordered two-draw outcomes.

Step 2: Counting favorable ordered draws gives \( 12 \) outcomes.

Step 3: Simplified probability = \( \frac{12}{72} = \frac{1}{6} \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: drawing with replacement uses denominator \( 81 \), whereas without replacement uses \( 72 \)!

en.question: A jar contains \( 5 \) red marbles and \( 4 \) blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn one after another without replacement. What is the probability that the two drawn marbles have the same color?
en.hint: Without replacement means the total drops from \( 9 \) on the 1st draw to \( 8 \) on the 2nd draw (\( 72 \) ordered pairs)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count ordered draws across \( 9 \times 8 = 72 \) outcomes without replacement!

Step 1: There are \( 9 \times 8 = 72 \) equally likely ordered two-draw outcomes.

Step 2: Counting favorable ordered draws gives \( 32 \) outcomes.

Step 3: Simplified probability = \( \frac{32}{72} = \frac{4}{9} \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: drawing with replacement uses denominator \( 81 \), whereas without replacement uses \( 72 \)!

en.hint: Without replacement means the total drops from \( 10 \) on the 1st draw to \( 9 \) on the 2nd draw (\( 90 \) ordered pairs)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count ordered draws across \( 10 \times 9 = 90 \) outcomes without replacement!

Step 1: There are \( 10 \times 9 = 90 \) equally likely ordered two-draw outcomes.

Step 2: Counting favorable ordered draws gives \( 48 \) outcomes.

Step 3: Simplified probability = \( \frac{48}{90} = \frac{8}{15} \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap avoided: drawing with replacement uses denominator \( 100 \), whereas without replacement uses \( 90 \)!

en.question: A crate of robotics kits contains the smallest positive number \( N \) of items that leaves remainder \( 3 \) when packed into boxes of \( 4 \) and remainder \( 5 \) when packed into boxes of \( 7 \). Find \( N \).
en.hint: List numbers of the form \( 5 + 7k \) and test which one leaves remainder \( 3 \) modulo \( 4 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Step through candidates congruent to \( 5 \) modulo the larger divisor \( 7 \)!

Step 1: Positive integers leaving remainder \( 5 \) modulo \( 7 \) are \( 5, 12, 19, 26 \), ...

Step 2: Test each modulo \( 4 \) until remainder \( 3 \) appears: \( 19 = 4 \times 4 + 3 \).

Step 3: Since \( \gcd(4, 7) = 1 \), \( N = 19 \) is the unique solution in \( 1 \le N \le 28 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 19 \bmod 4 = 3 \) and \( 19 \bmod 7 = 5 \).

ar.question: يحتوي صندوق على أصغر عدد موجب \( N \) من القطع بحيث يترك باقياً قدره \( 3 \) عند توزيعه في علب تسع \( 4 \) قطع، وباقياً قدره \( 5 \) عند توزيعه في علب تسع \( 7 \) قطع. أوجد \( N \).
ar.hint: اسرد الأعداد من الصورة \( 5 + 7k \) واختبر أول عدد يعطي الباقي \( 3 \) عند قسمته على \( 4 \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نقفز بمقدار المقسوم الأكبر \( 7 \) بدءاً من \( 5 \) حتى يتحقق شرط القسمة على \( 4 \)!

الخطوة 1: الأعداد التي تترك الباقي \( 5 \) على \( 7 \) هي: \( 5, 12, 19, 26 \)، ...

الخطوة 2: نفحص بواقيها على \( 4 \) فنجد \( 19 = 4 \times 4 + 3 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن أصغر عدد موجب يحقق الشرطين معاً هو \( 19 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: باقي قسمة \( 19 \) على \( 4 \) هو \( 3 \)، وعلى \( 7 \) هو \( 5 \).

en.question: A crate of laboratory vials contains the smallest positive number \( N \) of items that leaves remainder \( 2 \) when packed into boxes of \( 5 \) and remainder \( 7 \) when packed into boxes of \( 9 \). Find \( N \).
en.hint: List numbers of the form \( 7 + 9k \) and test which one leaves remainder \( 2 \) modulo \( 5 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Step through candidates congruent to \( 7 \) modulo the larger divisor \( 9 \)!

Step 1: Positive integers leaving remainder \( 7 \) modulo \( 9 \) are \( 7, 16, 25, 34 \), ...

Step 2: Test each modulo \( 5 \) until remainder \( 2 \) appears: \( 7 = 1 \times 5 + 2 \).

Step 3: Since \( \gcd(5, 9) = 1 \), \( N = 7 \) is the unique solution in \( 1 \le N \le 45 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 7 \bmod 5 = 2 \) and \( 7 \bmod 9 = 7 \).

en.question: Find the smallest three-digit positive integer \( N \) such that \( N \equiv 3 \pmod{5} \) and \( N \equiv 4 \pmod{9} \).
en.hint: First find the base solution \( N_0 = 13 \), then add multiples of \( \operatorname{lcm}(5, 9) = 45 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Combine both congruences into a single progression \( N = 13 + 45k \)!

Step 1: Stepping by \( 9 \) from \( 4 \) gives the smallest positive solution \( N_0 = 13 \).

Step 2: Since \( \operatorname{lcm}(5, 9) = 45 \), all solutions have the form \( N = 13 + 45k \).

Step 3: Choosing \( k = 2 \) yields the required three-digit value \( N = 103 \).

✅ Quick Check: Verify: \( 100 \le 103 \le 999 \), \( 103 \bmod 5 = 3 \), and \( 103 \bmod 9 = 4 \).

ar.hint: أوجد أولاً الحل الأساسي \( N_0 = 13 \) ثم أضف مضاعفات \( \operatorname{lcm}(5, 9) = 45 \).

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( N \) satisfying the three simultaneous congruences \( N \equiv 2 \pmod{3} \), \( N \equiv 3 \pmod{5} \), and \( N \equiv 4 \pmod{7} \)?
en.hint: Merge the first two moduli into \( N \equiv 8 \pmod{15} \), then step by \( 15 \) to match modulo \( 7 \).

💡 Key Idea: Solve two moduli first, then step by \( 3 \times 5 = 15 \) against \( 7 \)!

Step 1: From \( N \equiv 2 \pmod{3} \) and \( N \equiv 3 \pmod{5} \), we get \( N \equiv 8 \pmod{15} \).

Step 2: Test terms \( 8, 23, 38, \dots \) modulo \( 7 \).

Step 3: The first term leaving remainder \( 4 \) modulo \( 7 \) is \( N = 53 \).

✅ Quick Check: Triple check: \( 53 \bmod 3 = 2 \), \( 53 \bmod 5 = 3 \), and \( 53 \bmod 7 = 4 \).

ar.hint: ادمج التطابقين الأولين في \( N \equiv 8 \pmod{15} \) ثم اقفز بمقدار \( 15 \) لتحقيق التطابق الثالث.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحل أول تطابقين معاً فنحصل على باقٍ وحيد للمقاس \( 15 \) ثم نختبر مضاعفاته مع \( 7 \)!

الخطوة 1: دمج الشرطين الأولين يعطي \( N \equiv 8 \pmod{15} \).

الخطوة 2: نختبر حدود المتتالية \( 8 + 15t \) عند القسمة على \( 7 \).

الخطوة 3: أول حد يعطي الباقي \( 4 \) على \( 7 \) هو \( N = 53 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق ثلاثي: \( 53 \) يحقق البواقي \( 2 \) و\( 3 \) و\( 4 \) جميعاً.

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( N \) satisfying the three simultaneous congruences \( N \equiv 1 \pmod{3} \), \( N \equiv 3 \pmod{4} \), and \( N \equiv 5 \pmod{7} \)?
en.hint: Merge the first two moduli into \( N \equiv 7 \pmod{12} \), then step by \( 12 \) to match modulo \( 7 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Solve two moduli first, then step by \( 3 \times 4 = 12 \) against \( 7 \)!

Step 1: From \( N \equiv 1 \pmod{3} \) and \( N \equiv 3 \pmod{4} \), we get \( N \equiv 7 \pmod{12} \).

Step 2: Test terms \( 7, 19, 31, \dots \) modulo \( 7 \).

Step 3: The first term leaving remainder \( 5 \) modulo \( 7 \) is \( N = 19 \).

✅ Quick Check: Triple check: \( 19 \bmod 3 = 1 \), \( 19 \bmod 4 = 3 \), and \( 19 \bmod 7 = 5 \).

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( N \) satisfying the three simultaneous congruences \( N \equiv 1 \pmod{4} \), \( N \equiv 4 \pmod{5} \), and \( N \equiv 2 \pmod{7} \)?
en.hint: Merge the first two moduli into \( N \equiv 9 \pmod{20} \), then step by \( 20 \) to match modulo \( 7 \).

✅ Quick Check: Triple check: \( 9 \bmod 4 = 1 \), \( 9 \bmod 5 = 4 \), and \( 9 \bmod 7 = 2 \).

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( N \) satisfying the three simultaneous congruences \( N \equiv 2 \pmod{3} \), \( N \equiv 1 \pmod{5} \), and \( N \equiv 5 \pmod{8} \)?
en.hint: Merge the first two moduli into \( N \equiv 11 \pmod{15} \), then step by \( 15 \) to match modulo \( 8 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Solve two moduli first, then step by \( 3 \times 5 = 15 \) against \( 8 \)!

Step 1: From \( N \equiv 2 \pmod{3} \) and \( N \equiv 1 \pmod{5} \), we get \( N \equiv 11 \pmod{15} \).

Step 2: Test terms \( 11, 26, 41, \dots \) modulo \( 8 \).

Step 3: The first term leaving remainder \( 5 \) modulo \( 8 \) is \( N = 101 \).

✅ Quick Check: Triple check: \( 101 \bmod 3 = 2 \), \( 101 \bmod 5 = 1 \), and \( 101 \bmod 8 = 5 \).

en.question: How many consecutive zeros appear at the right end of \( 45! \) when written in standard base-\( 10 \) notation?
en.hint: Apply Legendre's formula \( \lfloor n/5 \rfloor + \lfloor n/25 \rfloor + \lfloor n/125 \rfloor \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count the total exponent of prime \( 5 \) in \( 45! \)!

Step 1: Multiples of \( 5 \) contribute \( \lfloor 45/5 \rfloor = 9 \) factors of \( 5 \).

Step 2: Multiples of \( 25 \) add \( \lfloor 45/25 \rfloor = 1 \), and multiples of \( 125 \) add \( \lfloor 45/125 \rfloor = 0 \).

Step 3: Total trailing zeros: \( 9 + 1 + 0 = 10 \).

✅ Quick Check: Notice \( 9 \) alone misses the \( 1 \) extra factors of \( 5 \) from higher powers!

ar.question: كم صفراً متتالياً يظهر في أقصى يمين العدد \( 45! \) عند كتابته بالنظام العشري؟
ar.hint: طبّق صيغة ليجاندر لقوى الخمسة: \( \lfloor n/5 \rfloor + \lfloor n/25 \rfloor + \lfloor n/125 \rfloor \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب الأس الكلي للعامل الأولي \( 5 \) في تحليل \( 45! \)!

الخطوة 1: مضاعفات \( 5 \) تعطي \( \lfloor 45/5 \rfloor = 9 \).

الخطوة 2: مضاعفات \( 25 \) تضيف \( 1 \)، ومضاعفات \( 125 \) تضيف \( 0 \).

الخطوة 3: مجموع الأصفار الطرفية هو \( 9 + 1 + 0 = 10 \).

ar.question: كم صفراً متتالياً يظهر في أقصى يمين العدد \( 140! \) عند كتابته بالنظام العشري؟
ar.hint: طبّق صيغة ليجاندر لقوى الخمسة: \( \lfloor n/5 \rfloor + \lfloor n/25 \rfloor + \lfloor n/125 \rfloor \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب الأس الكلي للعامل الأولي \( 5 \) في تحليل \( 140! \)!

الخطوة 1: مضاعفات \( 5 \) تعطي \( \lfloor 140/5 \rfloor = 28 \).

الخطوة 2: مضاعفات \( 25 \) تضيف \( 5 \)، ومضاعفات \( 125 \) تضيف \( 1 \).

الخطوة 3: مجموع الأصفار الطرفية هو \( 28 + 5 + 1 = 34 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عوامل العدد \( 2 \) أكثر بكثير من عوامل \( 5 \)، لذا يحدد أس الـ \( 5 \) عدد الأصفار.

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( n \) such that \( n! \) ends in at least \( 12 \) trailing zeros?
en.hint: Remember \( n! \) gains new zeros only at multiples of \( 5 \), and \( n \) is slightly smaller than \( 5 \times 12 = 60 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Estimate \( n \approx 4z \), then test multiples of \( 5 \) with Legendre's sum!

Step 1: Since \( n/5 + n/25 \approx 6n/25 \), estimate \( n \approx \frac{25 \times 12}{6} \approx 50 \).

Step 2: At \( n = 50 \), \( Z(50!) = 10 + 2 + 0 = 12 \).

Step 3: For \( n = 49 \), \( Z(49!) = 10 < 12 \), so \( 50 \) is minimal.

✅ Quick Check: Naive multiplication \( 5 \times 12 = 60 \) overshoots because multiples of \( 25 \) supply bonus \( 5 \)'s!

ar.hint: تذكّر أن عدد الأصفار يقفز فقط عند مضاعفات \( 5 \)، وأن \( n \) أصغر قليلاً من \( 60 \) بسبب مضاعفات \( 25 \).

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer \( n \) such that \( n! \) ends in at least \( 22 \) trailing zeros?
en.hint: Remember \( n! \) gains new zeros only at multiples of \( 5 \), and \( n \) is slightly smaller than \( 5 \times 22 = 110 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Estimate \( n \approx 4z \), then test multiples of \( 5 \) with Legendre's sum!

Step 1: Since \( n/5 + n/25 \approx 6n/25 \), estimate \( n \approx \frac{25 \times 22}{6} \approx 92 \).

Step 2: At \( n = 95 \), \( Z(95!) = 19 + 3 + 0 = 22 \).

Step 3: For \( n = 94 \), \( Z(94!) = 21 < 22 \), so \( 95 \) is minimal.

✅ Quick Check: Naive multiplication \( 5 \times 22 = 110 \) overshoots because multiples of \( 25 \) supply bonus \( 5 \)'s!

en.question: When \( 50! \) is written in base \( 12 \), in how many consecutive trailing zeros does it end?
en.hint: Factor the base \( 12 = 2^2 \times 3 \); each trailing zero requires a full copy of \( 2^2 \times 3 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count prime exponents of \( 2 \) and \( 3 \) in \( 50! \), then take \( \min(\lfloor v_{2}/2 \rfloor, \lfloor v_{3}/1 \rfloor) \)!

Step 1: Factor the base: \( 12 = 2^2 \times 3 \).

Step 2: By Legendre's formula, \( v_{2}(50!) = 47 \) (giving \( \lfloor 47/2 \rfloor = 23 \) blocks) and \( v_{3}(50!) = 22 \) (giving \( \lfloor 22/1 \rfloor = 22 \) blocks).

Step 3: The limiting prime-power block count is \( \min(23, 22) = 22 \).

✅ Quick Check: Always check both prime powers when a prime has exponent \( >1 \) in the base!

en.question: How many positive integers \( n \) with \( 1 \le n \le 300 \) have an odd number of positive divisors?
en.hint: Pair each divisor \( d \) with \( n/d \): when is \( d = n/d \)?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: An integer has an odd number of positive divisors if and only if it is a perfect square!

Step 1: Divisors of \( n \) pair up as \( (d, n/d) \), leaving an unpaired divisor iff \( n = k^2 \).

Step 2: Count perfect squares \( 1^2, 2^2, \dots, k^2 \le 300 \).

Step 3: Since \( 17^2 = 289 \le 300 \) (and \( 18^2 = 324 > 300 \)), there are \( 17 \) such integers.

✅ Quick Check: Square boundary check: \( 17^2 = 289 \) fits inside \( 300 \), while \( 324 \) exceeds \( 300 \).

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً \( n \) يحقق \( 1 \le n \le 300 \) وله عدد فردي من القواسم الموجبة؟
ar.hint: زاوج كل قاسم \( d \) مع \( n/d \)؛ متى يندمج الزوج في عدد واحد \( d = n/d \)؟
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: يكون لعدد موجب عدد فردي من القواسم إذا وفقط إذا كان مربعاً كاملاً!

الخطوة 1: تتزاوج القواسم على صورة \( (d, n/d) \) ولا يبقى قاسم منفرد إلا عندما \( n = k^2 \).

الخطوة 2: نحصي المربعات الكاملة من \( 1^2 \) حتى \( 300 \).

الخطوة 3: بما أن \( \lfloor \sqrt{300} \rfloor = 17 \)، يوجد \( 17 \) عدداً.

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( 17^2 = 289 \le 300 < 324 \).

en.question: How many positive divisors of \( 360 \) are multiples of \( 2 \)?
en.hint: Write every such divisor as \( d = 2m \); then \( m \) can be any positive divisor of \( 360/2 = 180 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Factor out \( 2 \) first: counting multiples of \( 2 \) dividing \( 360 \) equals counting all divisors of \( 180 \)!

Step 1: Set \( d = 2m \). Then \( d \mid 360 \iff m \mid \frac{360}{2} = 180 \).

Step 2: Prime-factorize \( 180 = 2^2 \times 3^2 \times 5 \).

Step 3: Adding \( 1 \) to each prime exponent and multiplying gives \( 18 \) divisors.

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( 18 \) is strictly less than the total divisor count \( 24 \) of \( 360 \).

en.question: How many positive divisors of \( 720 \) are multiples of \( 6 \)?
en.hint: Write every such divisor as \( d = 6m \); then \( m \) can be any positive divisor of \( 720/6 = 120 \)!

en.question: What is the smallest positive integer that has exact \( 12 \) positive divisors?
en.hint: Factor \( 12 \) into ways of writing \( (a+1)(b+1)\cdots = 12 \) and assign larger exponents to the smallest primes \( 2, 3, 5 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Test exponent shapes multiplying to \( 12 \) on the smallest primes \( 2, 3, 5, \dots \)!

Step 1: Write \( 12 \) as a product of factors \( \ge 2 \) and assign non-increasing exponents \( e_1 \ge e_2 \ge \cdots \) to primes \( 2, 3, 5, \dots \).

Step 2: Comparing candidate prime-power products shows \( 2^2 \times 3 \times 5 = 60 \) beats single-prime or fewer-prime shapes.

Step 3: Thus the minimal positive integer with \( 12 \) divisors is \( 60 \).

✅ Quick Check: Verify: \( \tau(60) = 12 \), and no smaller integer achieves \( 12 \) divisors.

ar.question: ما أصغر عدد صحيح موجب له بالضبط \( 12 \) قاسماً موجباً؟
ar.hint: حلّل \( 12 \) إلى جداء عوامل \( (a+1)(b+1)\cdots \) وامنح الأسس الأكبر لأصغر الأعداد الأولية \( 2, 3, 5 \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نقارن جميع طرق تحليل \( 12 \) ونضع الأسس الأكبر على أصغر الأعداد الأولية \( 2, 3, 5 \)!

الخطوة 1: نكتب \( 12 \) كحاصل ضرب عوامل \( (e_i + 1) \) ونرتب الأسس تنازلياً على \( 2, 3, 5 \).

الخطوة 2: بمقارنة المرشحين نجد أن أصغر قيمة هي \( 2^2 \times 3 \times 5 = 60 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن أصغر عدد موجب له \( 12 \) قاسماً هو \( 60 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عدد قواسم \( 60 \) يساوي \( 12 \) تماماً.

💡 Key Idea: Test exponent shapes multiplying to \( 18 \) on the smallest primes \( 2, 3, 5, \dots \)!

Step 1: Write \( 18 \) as a product of factors \( \ge 2 \) and assign non-increasing exponents \( e_1 \ge e_2 \ge \cdots \) to primes \( 2, 3, 5, \dots \).

Step 2: Comparing candidate prime-power products shows \( 2^2 \times 3^2 \times 5 = 180 \) beats single-prime or fewer-prime shapes.

Step 3: Thus the minimal positive integer with \( 18 \) divisors is \( 180 \).

✅ Quick Check: Verify: \( \tau(180) = 18 \), and no smaller integer achieves \( 18 \) divisors.

ar.question: ما أصغر عدد صحيح موجب له بالضبط \( 18 \) قاسماً موجباً؟
ar.hint: حلّل \( 18 \) إلى جداء عوامل \( (a+1)(b+1)\cdots \) وامنح الأسس الأكبر لأصغر الأعداد الأولية \( 2, 3, 5 \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نقارن جميع طرق تحليل \( 18 \) ونضع الأسس الأكبر على أصغر الأعداد الأولية \( 2, 3, 5 \)!

الخطوة 1: نكتب \( 18 \) كحاصل ضرب عوامل \( (e_i + 1) \) ونرتب الأسس تنازلياً على \( 2, 3, 5 \).

الخطوة 2: بمقارنة المرشحين نجد أن أصغر قيمة هي \( 2^2 \times 3^2 \times 5 = 180 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن أصغر عدد موجب له \( 18 \) قاسماً هو \( 180 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عدد قواسم \( 180 \) يساوي \( 18 \) تماماً.

en.question: Two positive integers \( a \) and \( b \) satisfy \( \gcd(a, b) = 6 \) and \( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 180 \). If \( a = 30 \), what is \( b \)?
en.hint: Use the fundamental identity \( a \times b = \gcd(a, b) \times \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) \).

en.question: Two positive integers \( a \) and \( b \) satisfy \( \gcd(a, b) = 9 \) and \( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 315 \). If \( a = 45 \), what is \( b \)?
en.hint: Use the fundamental identity \( a \times b = \gcd(a, b) \times \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply \( ab = gL \) directly!

Step 1: For any two positive integers, \( a \cdot b = \gcd(a,b) \cdot \operatorname{lcm}(a,b) \).

Step 2: Substitute \( 45 \cdot b = 9 \times 315 = 2835 \).

Step 3: Divide by \( 45 \): \( b = 2835 / 45 = 63 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( \gcd(45, 63) = 9 \) and \( \operatorname{lcm}(45, 63) = 315 \).

en.question: How many ordered pairs \( (a, b) \) of positive integers satisfy \( \gcd(a, b) = 4 \) and \( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 120 \)?
en.hint: Write \( a = 4x, b = 4y \) with \( \gcd(x, y) = 1 \) so \( xy = 120/4 = 30 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count distinct prime factors \( k \) of \( L/g = 30 \); the ordered pair count is \( 2^k \)!

Step 1: Let \( a = 4x \) and \( b = 4y \) with \( \gcd(x, y) = 1 \); then \( xy = 120/4 = 30 \).

Step 2: Factor \( 30 = 2 \times 3 \times 5 \), which has \( k = 3 \) distinct prime-power blocks.

Step 3: Each block goes wholly to \( x \) or wholly to \( y \), yielding \( 2^{3} = 8 \) ordered pairs.

✅ Quick Check: Unordered pairs would be \( 4 \), whereas ordered pairs count both \( (a,b) \) and \( (b,a) \) to give \( 8 \).

ar.question: كم زوجاً مرتباً \( (a, b) \) من الأعداد الصحيحة الموجبة يحقق \( \gcd(a, b) = 4 \) و\( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 120 \)؟

💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب عدد العوامل الأولية المختلفة \( k \) للخارج \( L/g = 30 \) فيكون الجواب \( 2^k \)!

الخطوة 2: تحليل \( 30 = 2 \times 3 \times 5 \) يضم \( 3 \) قوى أولية مستقلة.

الخطوة 3: تتوزع كل قوة كاملة على \( x \) أو \( y \) بطريقتين، فيكون العدد \( 2^{3} = 8 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: انتبه: المطلوب الأزواج المرتبة ولذلك الجواب \( 8 \) وليس نصفه \( 4 \).

en.question: Positive integers \( a \) and \( b \) satisfy \( \gcd(a, b) = 6 \) and \( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 360 \). What is the minimum possible value of \( a + b \)?
en.hint: Write \( a + b = 6(x + y) \) where \( xy = 60 \) and \( \gcd(x, y) = 1 \); choose \( x, y \) as close together as possible!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Minimize \( x + y \) over coprime factor pairs of \( L/g = 60 \)!

Step 1: Set \( a = 6x \) and \( b = 6y \) with \( \gcd(x, y) = 1 \) and \( xy = 360/6 = 60 \).

Step 2: To minimize \( x + y \), pick coprime factors of \( 60 \) closest to \( \sqrt{60} \).

Step 3: Multiplying that minimal sum \( 17 \) by \( 6 \) gives \( a + b = 102 \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap check: non-coprime factorizations of \( 60 \) are invalid because they increase \( \gcd(a, b) \) above \( 6 \)!

ar.question: يحقق العددان الصحيحان الموجبان \( a \) و\( b \) الشرطين \( \gcd(a, b) = 6 \) و\( \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = 360 \). ما أصغر قيمة ممكنة للمجموع \( a + b \)؟
ar.hint: اكتب \( a + b = 6(x + y) \) حيث \( xy = 60 \) و\( \gcd(x, y) = 1 \)، واختر \( x, y \) متقاربين قدر الإمكان!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نبحث عن عاملين أوليين نسبياً للعدد \( 60 \) متقاربين قدر الإمكان لتصغير \( x + y \)!

الخطوة 1: بوضع \( a = 6x, b = 6y \) يكون \( xy = 60 \) مع شرط \( \gcd(x,y) = 1 \).

الخطوة 2: أقرب عاملين أوليين نسبياً لجذر \( 60 \) يعطيان أصغر مجموع \( x + y = 17 \).

en.question: Convert the base-\( 4 \) numeral \( (231)_{4} \) into standard base-\( 10 \) notation.
en.hint: Expand \( 2 \cdot 4^2 + 3 \cdot 4 + 1 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Multiply each digit by its positional power of \( 4 \)!

Step 1: Write place values: \( (231)_{4} = 2 \times 4^2 + 3 \times 4 + 1 \).

Step 2: Evaluate powers: \( 32 + 12 + 1 \).

Step 3: Add to obtain \( 45 \) in base \( 10 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: every digit in \( 231 \) is strictly less than \( 4 \), and \( 45 = (231)_{4} \).

ar.question: حوّل العدد المكتوب في الأساس \( 4 \) وهو \( (231)_{4} \) إلى النظام العشري.
ar.hint: افكك القيم المكانية للخانات: \( 2 \cdot 4^2 + 3 \cdot 4 + 1 \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نضرب كل خانة في القوة المقابلة للأساس \( 4 \) ثم نجمع!

الخطوة 1: نفك العدد: \( 2 \times 4^2 + 3 \times 4 + 1 \).

الخطوة 2: نحسب الحدود: \( 32 + 12 + 1 \).

en.question: In what positive integer base \( b > 4 \) is the addition \( (24)_b + (33)_b = (101)_b \) valid?
en.hint: Look at the units column \( 4 + 3 = b + 1 \) (or expand all three numerals in powers of \( b \)).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Expand both sides in powers of \( b \) (or read the carry from the units column)!

Step 1: In the units place, \( 4 + 3 = 7 \), which leaves digit \( 1 \) with carry \( 1 \), so \( b = 7 - 1 = 6 \).

Step 2: Check the full quadratic: \( (2b + 4) + (3b + 3) = b^2 + 0b + 1 \).

Step 3: Substituting \( b = 6 \) gives \( 16 + 21 = 37 \), confirming \( b = 6 \).

✅ Quick Check: All digits are \( \le 4 < 6 \), so \( b = 6 \) is completely valid!

ar.question: في أي أساس عددي صحيح موجب \( b > 4 \) تتحقق عملية الجمع \( (24)_b + (33)_b = (101)_b \)؟
ar.hint: انظر إلى عمود الآحاد \( 4 + 3 = b + 1 \) أو حوّل الحدود الثلاثة إلى قوى \( b \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نفك الأعداد الثلاثة بدلالة قوى \( b \) أو نستنتج قيمة \( b \) مباشرة من حمل خانة الآحاد!

الخطوة 1: مجموع خانتي الآحاد \( 4 + 3 = 7 \) ويكتب \( 1 \) مع حمل \( 1 \)، إذن \( b = 6 \).

الخطوة 2: نتحقق في عمود العشرات: \( 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 = 1 \cdot 6 + 0 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن الأساس الصحيح الوحيد هو \( b = 6 \).

en.hint: Look at the units column \( 5 + 6 = b + 3 \) (or expand all three numerals in powers of \( b \)).

en.question: In what positive integer base \( b > 7 \) is the addition \( (67)_b + (56)_b = (112)_b \) valid?
en.hint: Look at the units column \( 7 + 6 = b + 2 \) (or expand all three numerals in powers of \( b \)).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Expand both sides in powers of \( b \) (or read the carry from the units column)!

Step 1: In the units place, \( 7 + 6 = 13 \), which leaves digit \( 2 \) with carry \( 1 \), so \( b = 13 - 2 = 11 \).

Step 2: Check the full quadratic: \( (6b + 7) + (5b + 6) = b^2 + 1b + 2 \).

Step 3: Substituting \( b = 11 \) gives \( 73 + 61 = 134 \), confirming \( b = 11 \).

✅ Quick Check: All digits are \( \le 7 < 11 \), so \( b = 11 \) is completely valid!

en.question: Nonzero digits \( a \) and \( b \) (both valid in base \( 5 \)) satisfy \( (\overline{ab})_{5} = (\overline{ba})_{7} \). Express the common value of this number in base \( 10 \).
en.hint: Expand \( 5a + b = 7b + a \) and use \( 1 \le a, b < 5 \) to pin down \( (a, b) \) uniquely!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Equate the base-\( 10 \) expansions and apply the base-\( 5 \) digit bound \( a < 5 \)!

Step 1: Expand both sides: \( 5a + b = 7b + a \implies 4a = 6b \).

Step 2: Divide by \( 2 \): \( 2a = 3b \). Since \( 1 \le a, b < 5 \), the unique digit pair is \( (a, b) = (3, 2) \).

Step 3: Evaluate in base \( 10 \): \( 5(3) + 2 = 17 \) (which also equals \( 7(2) + 3 = 17 \)).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( (32)_{5} = 17 = (23)_{7} \)!

الخطوة 1: بفك الطرفين: \( 9a + b = 11b + a \implies 8a = 10b \).

الخطوة 2: بالتبسيط ومراعاة أن الخانات أصغر من \( 9 \)، الحل الوحيد هو \( (a, b) = (5, 4) \).

الخطوة 3: القيمة العشرية تساوي \( 9 \times 5 + 4 = 49 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( 11 \times 4 + 5 = 49 \) أيضاً!

en.question: How many \( 2 \)-digit positive integers have strictly increasing digits from left to right (for example, \( 12 \))?
en.hint: Can \( 0 \) ever appear if the leftmost digit is at least \( 1 \) and digits strictly increase?
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Every subset of \( 2 \) distinct digits from \( \{1, 2, \dots, 9\} \) sorts into exact one strictly increasing \( 2 \)-digit integer!

Step 1: Since \( d_1 \ge 1 \) and \( d_1 < d_2 < \cdots < d_k \), the digit \( 0 \) can never occur.

Step 2: Choose any \( 2 \) distinct digits from \( \{1, 2, \dots, 9\} \); there is only \( 1 \) increasing order for them.

Step 3: Compute \( \binom{9}{2} = 36 \).

✅ Quick Check: Using \( \binom{10}{2} = 45 \) is the classic trap of accidentally allowing a leading \( 0 \)!

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً مكوناً من \( 2 \) خانات تكون أرقامه متزايدة قطعيّاً من اليسار إلى اليمين (مثل \( 12 \))؟
ar.hint: هل يمكن أن يظهر الصفر إذا كانت الخانة اليسرى \( \ge 1 \) والأرقام تتزايد قطعيّاً؟

💡 الفكرة الأساسية: كل مجموعة جزئية من \( 2 \) أرقام مختارة من \( \{1,\dots,9\} \) ترتّب تصاعدياً بطريقة وحيدة!

الخطوة 1: يستحيل ظهور الرقم \( 0 \) لأن أصغر خانة تقع في أقصى اليسار ويجب أن تكون \( \ge 1 \).

الخطوة 2: نختار \( 2 \) أرقام مختلفة من أصل \( 9 \) أرقام متاحة.

الخطوة 3: الناتج هو \( \binom{9}{2} = 36 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: انتبه: اختيار \( \binom{10}{2} \) يقع في فخ السماح بصفر في الخانة اليسرى!

en.question: How many three-digit positive integers \( \overline{abc} \) have strictly decreasing digits \( a > b > c \)?
en.hint: Here \( 0 \) is allowed as the units digit \( c \), and any \( 3 \) distinct digits from \( \{0,1,\dots,9\} \) automatically have largest digit \( a \ge 2 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Choose any \( 3 \) distinct digits from all \( 10 \) digits \( \{0, 1, \dots, 9\} \) and place them in decreasing order!

Step 1: Unlike increasing numbers, \( c = 0 \) is valid (e.g. \( 210 \)), and \( a > b > c \ge 0 \) forces \( a \ge 2 \neq 0 \).

Step 2: Every \( 3 \)-element subset of \( \{0, 1, \dots, 9\} \) yields a unique decreasing number \( \overline{abc} \).

Step 3: Compute \( \binom{10}{3} = \frac{10 \times 9 \times 8}{6} = 120 \).

✅ Quick Check: Compare carefully: strictly increasing \( 3 \)-digit numbers equal \( \binom{9}{3} = 84 \), while strictly decreasing equal \( \binom{10}{3} = 120 \)!

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً من ثلاث خانات \( \overline{abc} \) يحقق الترتيب التنازلي القطعي \( a > b > c \)؟
ar.hint: هنا يُسمح بظهور الصفر في خانة الآحاد \( c \)، وأي \( 3 \) أرقام مختلفة من \( \{0,\dots,9\} \) يكون أكبرها \( a \ge 2 \) تلقائياً!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نختار أي \( 3 \) أرقام مختلفة من المجموعة الكاملة \( \{0,1,\dots,9\} \) ونرتبها تنازلياً!

الخطوة 1: يُسمح هنا بأن يكون \( c = 0 \)، وشرط \( a > b > c \) يضمن تلقائياً أن \( a \ge 2 \).

الخطوة 2: كل اختيار لـ \( 3 \) أرقام من \( 10 \) يحدد عدداً وحيداً تنازلياً.

الخطوة 3: العدد هو \( \binom{10}{3} = 120 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: مقارنة مهمة: المتزايدة قطعيّاً عددها \( 84 \)، أما المتناقصة قطعيّاً فعددها \( 120 \) لدخول الصفر!

en.question: How many \( 2 \)-digit positive integers are formed using only digits from \( \{1, 2, \dots, 9\} \) arranged in non-decreasing order (\( 1 \le d_1 \le \cdots \le d_2 \le 9 \))?
en.hint: Use combinations with repetition \( \binom{9 + 2 - 1}{2} \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Select \( 2 \) digits with repetition from \( 9 \) available nonzero digits via Stars and Bars!

Step 1: A non-decreasing sequence of length \( 2 \) from \( \{1,\dots,9\} \) is uniquely determined by how many times each digit is chosen.

Step 2: By Stars and Bars, there are \( \binom{9 + 2 - 1}{2} = \binom{10}{2} \) choices.

Step 3: Evaluating the binomial coefficient gives \( 45 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: strictly increasing choices \( \binom{9}{2} = 36 \) are a proper subset of all \( 45 \) non-decreasing numbers.

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً من \( 2 \) خانات يتكون من أرقام المجموعة \( \{1, 2, \dots, 9\} \) مرتبةً ترتيباً غير متناقص (\( 1 \le d_1 \le \cdots \le d_2 \le 9 \))؟
ar.hint: استخدم قانون التوافيق مع التكرار \( \binom{9 + 2 - 1}{2} \).
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نختار \( 2 \) أرقام مع السماح بالتكرار من بين \( 9 \) أرقام متاحة!

الخطوة 1: بمجرد تحديد مجموعة الأرقام المختارة (مع تكراراتها)، يوجد ترتيب غير متناقص وحيد لها.

الخطوة 2: نطبق صيغة النجوم والفواصل: \( \binom{9 + 2 - 1}{2} = \binom{10}{2} \).

الخطوة 3: بحساب التوافيق نحصل على \( 45 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: هذا العدد أكبر من حالة التزايد القطعي \( 36 \) لأنه يشمل تساوي الخانات.

en.question: How many \( 4 \)-digit positive integers are formed using only digits from \( \{1, 2, \dots, 7\} \) arranged in non-decreasing order (\( 1 \le d_1 \le \cdots \le d_4 \le 7 \))?
en.hint: Use combinations with repetition \( \binom{7 + 4 - 1}{4} \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Select \( 4 \) digits with repetition from \( 7 \) available nonzero digits via Stars and Bars!

en.question: How many \( 2 \)-digit positive integers have non-increasing digits from left to right (\( 9 \ge d_1 \ge \cdots \ge d_2 \ge 0 \) with \( d_1 \ge 1 \))?
en.hint: Choose \( 2 \) digits with repetition from all \( 10 \) digits \( \{0,\dots,9\} \), then subtract the single all-zero string!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count multisets of size \( 2 \) from \( \{0,\dots,9\} \) and exclude \( 00\dots 0 \)!

Step 1: Choosing \( 2 \) digits with repetition from \( \{0,1,\dots,9\} \) and sorting descending gives \( \binom{10 + 2 - 1}{2} = \binom{11}{2} = 55 \) strings.

Step 2: Every string has \( d_1 \ge 1 \) except the single all-zero string \( 00 \).

Step 3: Subtract \( 1 \): \( 55 - 1 = 54 \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap check: forgetting to exclude \( 00 \) gives \( 55 \)!

ar.hint: اختر \( 2 \) أرقام مع التكرار من الأرقام العشرة \( \{0,\dots,9\} \)، ثم اطرح حالة الأصفار الكاملة الوحيدة!

الخطوة 1: عدد الاختيارات مع التكرار من \( 10 \) أرقام هو \( \binom{11}{2} = 55 \).

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً من \( 3 \) خانات تكون أرقامه غير متزايدة من اليسار إلى اليمين (\( 9 \ge d_1 \ge \cdots \ge d_3 \ge 0 \) مع \( d_1 \ge 1 \))؟
ar.hint: اختر \( 3 \) أرقام مع التكرار من الأرقام العشرة \( \{0,\dots,9\} \)، ثم اطرح حالة الأصفار الكاملة الوحيدة!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحسب التوافيق مع التكرار من الأرقام العشرة \( \{0,\dots,9\} \) ثم نستبعد سلسلة الأصفار الوحيدة!

الخطوة 1: عدد الاختيارات مع التكرار من \( 10 \) أرقام هو \( \binom{12}{3} = 220 \).

الخطوة 2: الحالة الوحيدة التي تجعل \( d_1 = 0 \) هي اختيار الصفر \( 3 \) مرات (\( 000 \)).

الخطوة 3: نطرح \( 1 \) فنحصل على \( 219 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: انتبه: نسيان طرح حالة الأصفار يعطي الخيار الخاطئ \( 220 \)!

en.question: How many \( 4 \)-digit positive integers have non-increasing digits from left to right (\( 9 \ge d_1 \ge \cdots \ge d_4 \ge 0 \) with \( d_1 \ge 1 \))?
en.hint: Choose \( 4 \) digits with repetition from all \( 10 \) digits \( \{0,\dots,9\} \), then subtract the single all-zero string!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count multisets of size \( 4 \) from \( \{0,\dots,9\} \) and exclude \( 00\dots 0 \)!

Step 1: Choosing \( 4 \) digits with repetition from \( \{0,1,\dots,9\} \) and sorting descending gives \( \binom{10 + 4 - 1}{4} = \binom{13}{4} = 715 \) strings.

Step 2: Every string has \( d_1 \ge 1 \) except the single all-zero string \( 0000 \).

Step 3: Subtract \( 1 \): \( 715 - 1 = 714 \).

✅ Quick Check: Trap check: forgetting to exclude \( 0000 \) gives \( 715 \)!

en.question: A three-digit integer \( \overline{abc} \) is called a peak number if its middle digit is strictly larger than both neighbors (\( a < b \) and \( b > c \)). How many three-digit peak numbers exist?
en.hint: Casework on the middle peak digit \( b \in \{2, 3, \dots, 9\} \): note \( 1 \le a \le b - 1 \) while \( 0 \le c \le b - 1 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Fix the peak digit \( b \) and multiply the \( b - 1 \) choices for \( a \) by the \( b \) choices for \( c \)!

Step 1: For a given middle digit \( b \) (\( 2 \le b \le 9 \)), \( a \in \{1,\dots,b-1\} \) has \( b - 1 \) choices and \( c \in \{0,\dots,b-1\} \) has \( b \) choices.

Step 2: Sum \( (b - 1)b \) for \( b = 2, \dots, 9 \): \( 2 + 6 + 12 + 20 + 30 + 42 + 56 + 72 \).

Step 3: Adding (or using \( 2\binom{10}{3} = 2 \times 120 \)) gives \( 240 \).

✅ Quick Check: Elegant identity: \( \sum_{b=2}^9 2\binom{b}{2} = 2\binom{10}{3} = 240 \)!

ar.question: يُسمى العدد الثلاثي \( \overline{abc} \) عدداً قِمّياً إذا كان رقمه الأوسط أكبر قطعيّاً من جاريه (\( a < b \) و\( b > c \)). كم عدداً ثلاثياً قِمّياً يوجد؟
ar.hint: قسّم الحل بحسب قيمة الرقم الأوسط \( b \in \{2,\dots,9\} \)؛ لاحظ أن \( 1 \le a \le b-1 \) بينما \( 0 \le c \le b-1 \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نثبّت رقم القمة \( b \) فنضرب \( b - 1 \) خياراً للخانة \( a \) في \( b \) خياراً للخانة \( c \)!

الخطوة 1: لكل قيمة \( 2 \le b \le 9 \)، توجد \( b - 1 \) قيم لـ \( a \) (من \( 1 \) إلى \( b-1 \)) و\( b \) قيم لـ \( c \) (من \( 0 \) إلى \( b-1 \)).

الخطوة 2: نجمع \( 1\cdot 2 + 2\cdot 3 + \cdots + 8\cdot 9 = 2 + 6 + 12 + 20 + 30 + 42 + 56 + 72 \).

الخطوة 3: المجموع الكلي يساوي \( 240 \) عدداً قِمّياً.

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق جميل بمتطابقة عصا الهوكي: \( 2\sum_{b=2}^9 \binom{b}{2} = 2\binom{10}{3} = 240 \)!

en.question: Find the single digit \( d \in \{0,1,\dots,9\} \) such that the integer \( \overline{72d83} \) is divisible by \( 11 \).
en.hint: Use the alternating digit-sum test for \( 11 \) (odd positions minus even positions).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Set the alternating sum of digits congruent to \( 0 \pmod{11} \)!

Step 1: Compute the alternating sum of the digits of \( \overline{72d83} \).

Step 2: Require the alternating sum to be a multiple of \( 11 \).

Step 3: Since \( 0 \le d \le 9 \), the unique valid digit is \( d = 0 \).

✅ Quick Check: Division check: \( 72083 = 11 \times 6553 \)!

en.question: How many three-digit palindromes \( \overline{aba} \) (where \( a \ge 1 \)) are divisible by \( 3 \)?
en.hint: Write \( \overline{aba} = 101a + 10b \) and test which pairs \( (a, b) \) with \( 1 \le a \le 9,\; 0 \le b \le 9 \) satisfy \( 101a + 10b \equiv 0 \pmod{3} \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Reduce \( 101a + 10b \) modulo \( 3 \) and count valid choices of \( b \in \{0,\dots,9\} \) for each leading digit \( a \)!

Step 1: Every three-digit palindrome has the form \( \overline{aba} = 101a + 10b \) with \( a \in \{1,\dots,9\} \) and \( b \in \{0,\dots,9\} \).

Step 2: Reduce modulo \( 3 \): \( 2a + 1b \equiv 0 \pmod{3} \).

en.question: Using only arcade tokens worth \( 3 \) units and \( 7 \) units, what is the largest positive integer total that cannot be formed?
en.hint: Since \( \gcd(3, 7) = 1 \), apply Frobenius's formula \( ab - a - b \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: For two coprime denominations \( a \) and \( b \), the largest unattainable integer is \( ab - a - b \)!

Step 2: Compute \( 3 \times 7 - 3 - 7 = 21 - 10 = 11 \).

Step 3: Every integer \( \ge 12 \) can be expressed as \( 3x + 7y \) with \( x, y \ge 0 \).

✅ Quick Check: Quick check: \( 12 \) through \( 14 \) are \( 3 \) consecutive attainable totals!

en.question: Using only cargo weights worth \( 7 \) units and \( 10 \) units, what is the largest positive integer total that cannot be formed?
en.hint: Since \( \gcd(7, 10) = 1 \), apply Frobenius's formula \( ab - a - b \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: For two coprime denominations \( a \) and \( b \), the largest unattainable integer is \( ab - a - b \)!

Step 1: Verify \( \gcd(7, 10) = 1 \).

Step 2: Compute \( 7 \times 10 - 7 - 10 = 70 - 17 = 53 \).

Step 3: Every integer \( \ge 54 \) can be expressed as \( 7x + 10y \) with \( x, y \ge 0 \).

✅ Quick Check: Quick check: \( 54 \) through \( 60 \) are \( 7 \) consecutive attainable totals!

en.question: How many ordered pairs \( (x, y) \) of non-negative integers (\( x \ge 0,\; y \ge 0 \)) satisfy \( 3x + 5y = 60 \)?
en.hint: Find one solution (such as \( y = 0 \) or smallest \( y \ge 0 \)), then step \( y \) by \( 3 \) and \( x \) by \( -5 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Step through solutions using \( (x - 5t,\; y + 3t) \) while keeping both coordinates \( \ge 0 \)!

Step 1: In \( 3x + 5y = 60 \), \( 5y \equiv 60 \pmod{3} \) fixes \( y \) modulo \( 3 \).

Step 2: Valid values of \( y \) increase in steps of \( 3 \) inside \( 0 \le y \le \lfloor 60/5 \rfloor = 12 \).

Step 3: Counting those steps yields exact \( 5 \) non-negative pairs \( (x, y) \).

✅ Quick Check: Watch the boundary: positive solutions (\( x,y \ge 1 \)) may exclude \( x=0 \) or \( y=0 \), whereas non-negative includes them!

en.question: How many ordered pairs \( (x, y) \) of non-negative integers (\( x \ge 0,\; y \ge 0 \)) satisfy \( 5x + 9y = 135 \)?
en.hint: Find one solution (such as \( y = 0 \) or smallest \( y \ge 0 \)), then step \( y \) by \( 5 \) and \( x \) by \( -9 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Step through solutions using \( (x - 9t,\; y + 5t) \) while keeping both coordinates \( \ge 0 \)!

Step 1: In \( 5x + 9y = 135 \), \( 9y \equiv 135 \pmod{5} \) fixes \( y \) modulo \( 5 \).

Step 2: Valid values of \( y \) increase in steps of \( 5 \) inside \( 0 \le y \le \lfloor 135/9 \rfloor = 15 \).

Step 3: Counting those steps yields exact \( 4 \) non-negative pairs \( (x, y) \).

✅ Quick Check: Watch the boundary: positive solutions (\( x,y \ge 1 \)) may exclude \( x=0 \) or \( y=0 \), whereas non-negative includes them!

en.question: How many positive integers in total cannot be written in the form \( 5x + 9y \) for non-negative integers \( x, y \ge 0 \)?
en.hint: For coprime \( a, b \), exact half of the integers in \( [0, ab - a - b] \) are unattainable: \( \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{2} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply Sylvester's coin-problem count \( \frac{(a - 1)(b - 1)}{2} \)!

Step 1: Since \( \gcd(5, 9) = 1 \), pairing \( k \) with \( 31 - k \) matches each attainable integer in \( [0, 31] \) with an unattainable one.

Step 2: Thus the count of unattainable positive integers is \( \frac{(5 - 1)(9 - 1)}{2} = \frac{4 \times 8}{2} \).

Step 3: Evaluating gives \( 16 \) unattainable positive integers.

✅ Quick Check: Don't confuse the count of impossible integers (\( 16 \)) with the largest impossible integer (\( 31 \))!

ar.question: كم عدداً صحيحاً موجباً في المجموع لا يمكن كتابته على الصورة \( 5x + 9y \) لعددين صحيحين غير سالبين \( x, y \ge 0 \)؟
ar.hint: لأي عددين أوليين نسبياً \( a, b \)، عدد الأعداد الموجبة المستحيلة يساوي \( \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{2} \)!

الخطوة 1: بما أن \( \gcd(5, 9) = 1 \)، تتزاوج الأعداد في الفترة \( [0, 31] \) إلى أزواج مجموعها \( 31 \) أحدها ممكن والآخر مستحيل.

الخطوة 2: إذن عدد الأعداد الموجبة المستحيلة يساوي \( \frac{(5-1)(9-1)}{2} \).

الخطوة 3: بحساب المقدار نجد \( 16 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: انتبه لعدم الخلط بين عدد القيم المستحيلة (\( 16 \)) وأكبر قيمة مستحيلة (\( 31 \))!

en.question: How many positive integers in total cannot be written in the form \( 6x + 13y \) for non-negative integers \( x, y \ge 0 \)?
en.hint: For coprime \( a, b \), exact half of the integers in \( [0, ab - a - b] \) are unattainable: \( \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{2} \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Apply Sylvester's coin-problem count \( \frac{(a - 1)(b - 1)}{2} \)!

Step 1: Since \( \gcd(6, 13) = 1 \), pairing \( k \) with \( 59 - k \) matches each attainable integer in \( [0, 59] \) with an unattainable one.

Step 2: Thus the count of unattainable positive integers is \( \frac{(6 - 1)(13 - 1)}{2} = \frac{5 \times 12}{2} \).

Step 3: Evaluating gives \( 30 \) unattainable positive integers.

✅ Quick Check: Don't confuse the count of impossible integers (\( 30 \)) with the largest impossible integer (\( 59 \))!

en.question: Find the positive integer \( y \) that satisfies the unit-fraction equation \( \frac{1}{6} = \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{y} \).
en.hint: Subtract \( \frac{1}{y} = \frac{1}{6} - \frac{1}{9} \) using a common denominator.
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Isolate \( \frac{1}{y} \) and take the reciprocal!

Step 1: Write \( \frac{1}{y} = \frac{1}{6} - \frac{1}{9} = \frac{9 - 6}{6 \times 9} = \frac{3}{54} \).

Step 2: Simplify the fraction to \( \frac{1}{18} \).

Step 3: Therefore \( y = 18 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( (9 - 6)(18 - 6) = 3 \times 12 = 36 = 6^2 \)!

ar.question: أوجد العدد الصحيح الموجب \( y \) الذي يحقق معادلة الكسور الوحدية \( \frac{1}{6} = \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{y} \).
ar.hint: اطرح الكسرين: \( \frac{1}{y} = \frac{1}{6} - \frac{1}{9} \) بتوحيد المقامات.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نعزل \( \frac{1}{y} \) بتوحيد المقامات ثم نقلب الكسر الناتج!

الخطوة 1: نحسب \( \frac{1}{y} = \frac{9 - 6}{6 \times 9} = \frac{3}{54} \).

الخطوة 2: باختصار الكسر نحصل على \( \frac{1}{18} \).

الخطوة 3: إذن \( y = 18 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: \( \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{18} = \frac{1}{6} \).

Step 2: Simplify the fraction to \( \frac{1}{24} \).

Step 3: Therefore \( y = 24 \).

Step 2: Simplify the fraction to \( \frac{1}{30} \).

Step 3: Therefore \( y = 30 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( (15 - 10)(30 - 10) = 5 \times 20 = 100 = 10^2 \)!

en.question: Positive integers \( x \) and \( y \) satisfy \( \frac{1}{8} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \). What is the maximum possible value of \( x + y \)?
en.hint: Factor \( (x - 8)(y - 8) = 64 \); to maximize the sum of two positive factors of \( 64 \), choose \( 1 \times 64 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use \( (x - 8)(y - 8) = 8^2 \) and pick the most extreme divisor pair \( (1, 64) \)!

Step 1: Rewrite as \( (x - 8)(y - 8) = 64 \), so \( x + y = 2(8) + d + \frac{64}{d} \).

Step 2: The sum \( d + 64/d \) is maximized at \( d = 1 \), giving \( x = 9 \) and \( y = 72 \).

Step 3: Add them: \( 9 + 72 = 81 = (8+1)^2 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{72} = \frac{8 + 1}{8(8+1)} = \frac{1}{8} \)!

ar.question: عددان صحيحان موجبان \( x \) و\( y \) يحققان \( \frac{1}{8} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \). ما أكبر قيمة ممكنة للمجموع \( x + y \)؟
ar.hint: حلّل المعادلة إلى \( (x - 8)(y - 8) = 64 \)؛ لتكبير مجموع عاملين موجبين اختر الطرفين \( 1 \times 64 \)!
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نحوّل المعادلة إلى \( (x - 8)(y - 8) = 64 \) ونختار أبعد قاسمين \( 1 \) و\( 64 \)!

الخطوة 1: بوضع \( d = x - 8 \) نجد \( x + y = 16 + d + 64/d \).

الخطوة 2: أكبر مجموع لقاسمين موجبين للعدد \( 64 \) يتحقق عند \( 1 + 64 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن أكبر قيمة لـ \( x + y \) هي \( 16 + 1 + 64 = 81 \).

✅ التحقق من الحل: تحقق: عند \( x = 9, y = 72 \) يتحقق الكسر تماماً ومجموعهما \( 81 \).

en.question: Positive integers \( x \) and \( y \) satisfy \( \frac{1}{10} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \). What is the maximum possible value of \( x + y \)?
en.hint: Factor \( (x - 10)(y - 10) = 100 \); to maximize the sum of two positive factors of \( 100 \), choose \( 1 \times 100 \)!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Use \( (x - 10)(y - 10) = 10^2 \) and pick the most extreme divisor pair \( (1, 100) \)!

Step 1: Rewrite as \( (x - 10)(y - 10) = 100 \), so \( x + y = 2(10) + d + \frac{100}{d} \).

Step 2: The sum \( d + 100/d \) is maximized at \( d = 1 \), giving \( x = 11 \) and \( y = 110 \).

Step 3: Add them: \( 11 + 110 = 121 = (10+1)^2 \).

✅ Quick Check: Check: \( \frac{1}{11} + \frac{1}{110} = \frac{10 + 1}{10(10+1)} = \frac{1}{10} \)!

الخطوة 1: بوضع \( d = x - 10 \) نجد \( x + y = 20 + d + 100/d \).

الخطوة 2: أكبر مجموع لقاسمين موجبين للعدد \( 100 \) يتحقق عند \( 1 + 100 \).

الخطوة 3: إذن أكبر قيمة لـ \( x + y \) هي \( 20 + 1 + 100 = 121 \).

en.question: How many ordered pairs \( (x, y) \) of positive integers satisfy \( \frac{1}{6} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \)?
en.hint: Rewrite as \( (x - 6)(y - 6) = 6^2 = 36 \) and count positive divisors of \( 36 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count positive divisors \( \tau(6^2) \) via \( (x - 6)(y - 6) = 36 \)!

Step 1: Clearing denominators and adding \( 6^2 \) gives \( (x - 6)(y - 6) = 36 \).

Step 2: Prime-factorize \( 6^2 = 36 = 2^2 \times 3^2 \).

Step 3: The number of positive divisors (and hence ordered pairs) is \( 9 \).

en.question: How many pairs \( (x, y) \) of positive integers with \( x \le y \) satisfy \( \frac{1}{12} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \)?
en.hint: First compute \( \tau(12^2) = 15 \); don't forget the symmetric solution \( x = y = 24 \) before halving!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count ordered solutions \( \tau(12^2) \) and apply \( \frac{\tau(n^2) + 1}{2} \) for \( x \le y \)!

Step 1: From \( (x - 12)(y - 12) = 12^2 = 2^4 \times 3^2 \), there are \( \tau(12^2) = 15 \) ordered pairs.

Step 2: One pair has \( x = y = 24 \), while the other \( 14 \) pairs split equally between \( x < y \) and \( x > y \).

Step 3: Thus \( x \le y \) holds for \( 1 + \frac{15 - 1}{2} = \frac{15 + 1}{2} = 8 \) pairs.

✅ Quick Check: Notice \( 7 \) counts strictly \( x < y \), missing \( (24, 24) \)!

en.question: How many pairs \( (x, y) \) of positive integers with \( x \le y \) satisfy \( \frac{1}{24} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} \)?
en.hint: First compute \( \tau(24^2) = 21 \); don't forget the symmetric solution \( x = y = 48 \) before halving!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Count ordered solutions \( \tau(24^2) \) and apply \( \frac{\tau(n^2) + 1}{2} \) for \( x \le y \)!

Step 1: From \( (x - 24)(y - 24) = 24^2 = 2^6 \times 3^2 \), there are \( \tau(24^2) = 21 \) ordered pairs.

Step 2: One pair has \( x = y = 48 \), while the other \( 20 \) pairs split equally between \( x < y \) and \( x > y \).

Step 3: Thus \( x \le y \) holds for \( 1 + \frac{21 - 1}{2} = \frac{21 + 1}{2} = 11 \) pairs.

✅ Quick Check: Notice \( 10 \) counts strictly \( x < y \), missing \( (48, 48) \)!

en.question: If all positive integers from \( 1 \) through \( 50 \) inclusive are written side by side with no spaces (\( 1234567891011\dots50 \)), how many digits are written in total?
en.hint: Group by digit length: \( 1\text{–}9 \) (\( 9 \) numbers), \( 10\text{–}99 \) (\( 90 \) numbers), and \( 100\text{–}50 \) if \( N \ge 100 \).
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Sum digit counts block by block (watch the inclusive fencepost \( b - a + 1 \))!

Step 1: One-digit numbers \( 1\text{–}9 \) contribute \( 9 \times 1 = 9 \) digits.

Step 2: Two-digit numbers contribute \( 41 \times 2 = 82 \) digits.

Step 3: Adding the blocks gives \( 91 \) digits in total.

✅ Quick Check: Fencepost check: from \( 10 \) to \( 50 \) inclusive is \( 41 \), not \( 40 \)!

ar.question: إذا كُتبت جميع الأعداد الصحيحة الموجبة من \( 1 \) إلى \( 50 \) متجاورةً بلا فراغات (\( 1234567891011\dots50 \))، فكم خانة (رقماً) كُتبت في المجموع؟
ar.hint: قسّم الأعداد حسب عدد خاناتها: من \( 1 \) إلى \( 9 \)، ثم من \( 10 \) إلى \( 99 \)، ثم من \( 100 \) فصاعداً.
ar.explanation:
💡 الفكرة الأساسية: نجمع عدد الخانات لكل فئة مع الانتباه لقاعدة العد الشامل \( b - a + 1 \)!

الخطوة 1: الأعداد الأحادية \( 1\text{–}9 \) تعطي \( 9 \) خانات.

الخطوة 2: الأعداد الثنائية تعطي \( 82 \) خانة.

en.question: The positive integers are concatenated in order to form the infinite digit string \( 12345678910111213\dots \). What is the \( 125 \)-th digit from the left?
en.hint: Subtract \( 9 \) digits for \( 1\text{–}9 \) (and \( 180 \) digits for \( 10\text{–}99 \) if \( K > 189 \)) to locate the exact integer!
en.explanation:
💡 Key Idea: Peel off completed digit-length blocks, then divide by the digit width!

Step 1: Subtracting earlier digit blocks leaves position \( 116 \) inside the two-digit block starting at 10.

Step 2: Dividing \( 116 - 1 = 115 \) by \( 2 \) lands on the integer \( 67 \) at digit index \( 2 \) (from left).
